entities.name: Ratu Sir Kamisese Mara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of Fiji (1970–1992 (PM), 1993–2000 (President)). Alliance Party; founding father; led independence 1970; Paramount Chief Lau; balanced ethnic politics; PM 22 years; President from 1993; displaced in 2000 coup; died 2004; 'Father of the Nation'
